title: Cilantro Lime Rice
description: Fluffy long-grain rice tossed with fresh cilantro, lime zest and juice. The classic side for burritos, tacos and bowls.
equipment: Medium saucepan with a tight lid

image.alt: A bowl of white rice flecked with cilantro and lime zest

steps.text: Bring the rice, water, oil and salt to a boil in the saucepan.
Cover, turn the heat to low and simmer until the water is absorbed, {time 18 min}. Take off the heat and leave covered for {time 5 min}.
Fluff with a fork and fold in the lime zest, juice and cilantro.

notes: Add the lime and cilantro after cooking; heat dulls their fresh flavor.
